clue.text: Left in Paris — could be awkward

definitions.meaning: the French word for the left-hand side, as a Parisian would say it
clumsy and socially inept, a sense English borrowed from French

explanation.surface: Someone stranded in Paris could find things socially uncomfortable.
explanation.definitionFit: The French adjective for left also passed into English meaning tactless or socially clumsy.

clue.text: A nice rug spread out in Picasso painting

indicators.note: spread out signals that the letters of a nice rug are laid out afresh

explanation.surface: A pleasant carpet unrolled beneath a famous artwork.
explanation.definitionFit: Picasso's 1937 mural depicting the bombing of a Basque town.

clue.text: Possibly slips beneath surface of river

parts.note: under means beneath the surface
the Wear is a river in north-east England, through Durham

explanation.surface: Perhaps someone loses their footing below the water of a stream.
explanation.definitionFit: Slips, petticoats worn under a dress, are an example of undergarments.

clue.text: Try to sell a bird

definitions.meaning: to peddle goods noisily in the street
a bird of prey, such as a goshawk

explanation.definitionFit: Street peddling and a bird of prey share this four-letter word.

clue.text: Before starting treatment mention new remedy

indicators.note: Before places the rearranged word ahead of the following letter
new signals that the letters of mention are made over in a fresh order
starting picks the opening letter of the word treatment

explanation.surface: Before treatment begins, a doctor brings up a fresh cure.
explanation.definitionFit: A salve rubbed on the skin is a common healing remedy.

clue.text: Formally dressed Italians lacking a change

indicators.note: lacking says the following letter is taken from the pool of letters
change signals that the remaining letters of Italians are rearranged

explanation.surface: Smartly attired Italians without a spare set of clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Wearing a tailcoat, the long-tailed jacket of formal evening dress.

clue.text: Organ movement

parts.note: not a piece of organ music but the moving of a body organ from one person to another

explanation.definitionFit: Surgery moving a kidney or heart from a donor into a patient.

clue.text: What is left of a fire at the end of three months

definitions.text: What is left of a fire
definitions.meaning: a glowing piece of coal or wood in a dying fire

definitions.text: at the end of three months
definitions.meaning: September, November and December all close with these five letters

explanation.definitionFit: A still-glowing fragment remaining once a fire burns down.

clue.text: Revolutionary development in naval firepower

parts.note: revolutionary is literal: a gun housing that rotates, an innovation in warship armament

explanation.definitionFit: A rotating armoured gun housing on a warship, which swivels to aim.

clue.text: Put right and couple up again

definitions.meaning: to match in twos once more

explanation.definitionFit: Mending something and matching up couples a second time share the same letters.

clue.text: Contract women tend to break

indicators.note: to break signals that the letters of women and tend are smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: Women tend to break a legal agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: An insurance policy paying out a lump sum is a kind of contract, typically a life assurance arrangement.

clue.text: A doctor required — about to turn yellow!

parts.note: MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

indicators.note: to turn signals that the word for about is read backwards

parts.note: RE is a Latin-derived word meaning about or concerning

explanation.surface: A doctor is needed for someone about to go jaundiced.
explanation.definitionFit: A warm yellowish-orange colour, named after fossil resin.

clue.text: Grass to irritate

definitions.meaning: a police informer, British slang for someone who tells on others

explanation.definitionFit: British slang uses this word both for a police informer and, as a verb, for annoying someone.

clue.text: Shop Irishman is opening, with Republic's backing

indicators.note: opening says the first pieces start the answer, ahead of the rest

parts.note: Pat is a stock Irish man's name in crosswords
taken as written

indicators.note: backing signals the possessive name of the Irish state is read backwards

parts.note: Eire is the Irish name of the Republic of Ireland, with its possessive S

explanation.surface: An Irish shopkeeper opens up with the support of the Republic.
explanation.definitionFit: A French-style cake shop where pastries are baked and sold.

clue.text: Too far to charge from trenches in battle

definitions.text: to charge from trenches in battle
definitions.meaning: First World War soldiers went over the parapet to attack

explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for excess, from the First World War act of climbing out of a trench to attack.

clue.text: Smart enough to possess a chopper

indicators.note: to possess signals the word for smart holds the following letter inside it

parts.note: smart meaning intelligent or quick-witted

explanation.surface: Someone bright enough to own an axe.
explanation.definitionFit: A butcher's heavy broad-bladed knife used for chopping meat.

clue.text: Excitement created by the coming down of an astronaut

definitions.meaning: a sensation or stir, as in making a big impression in the news

definitions.text: the coming down of an astronaut
definitions.meaning: a spacecraft capsule landing in the sea, the noise and spray of hitting water

explanation.surface: Thrills generated as a space traveller returns to Earth.
explanation.definitionFit: A media sensation is so called, and capsules returned to Earth by landing in the ocean.

clue.text: A good man to break the latest news

parts.note: ST, for saint, is a good man
to oppress is to crush or break a people's spirit

explanation.surface: A decent fellow chosen to announce the newest headlines.
explanation.definitionFit: A late item added to a newspaper after printing has begun is labelled with this phrase.

clue.text: Around noon, top fighter pilots attempt descent

indicators.note: Around signals the word for star pilots surrounds the letter for noon

parts.note: aces are fighter pilots with many kills
a try is an attempt

explanation.surface: At midday, star airmen try to bring their planes down.
explanation.definitionFit: Descent in the sense of family lineage, one's forebears.

clue.text: Where the Ark went fast

parts.note: Noah's Ark came to rest on a mountain, held fast there as the flood waters went down

explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis Noah's vessel grounded on the mountains of this name in eastern Turkey.

clue.text: Agreed everything was bound to come out

indicators.note: was, read as was held by, signals the word for everything sits inside

parts.note: tied means bound
all means everything

explanation.surface: Agreed that the truth was sure to emerge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to come out' is a link: the figures that come out the same are said to agree.
explanation.definitionFit: Two sets of figures that match are said to correspond in this way.

clue.text: Indisposed to be criticised?

explanation.definitionFit: Someone tired and unwell is described with this phrase, and to disparage someone is to talk them down this way.

clue.text: Crêpe I cooked, instructions provided

indicators.note: cooked signals the letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: A pancake made with the directions supplied.
explanation.definitionFit: Directions for preparing a dish are given in this form.

clue.text: Used for washing, put out on pegs

indicators.note: put out signals the letters of on and pegs are disordered

explanation.surface: Laundry hung up on clothes pegs after a wash.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft porous bath item used to wash with.

clue.text: Bowl last ball in the dark

parts.note: to pitch is to throw or deliver a ball
in snooker the black is the last ball potted

explanation.surface: A cricketer delivers the final ball as the light fails.
explanation.walkthrough: Snooker is a cue sport in which the coloured balls are potted in order, finishing with the black.
explanation.definitionFit: Completely dark, without a glimmer of light, like a night with no moon.

clue.text: Medicine that may be mixed with gin

definitions.text: that may be mixed with gin
definitions.meaning: the quinine-flavoured fizzy mixer in a G and T

explanation.definitionFit: A restorative drink and the quinine mixer for gin share this word.

clue.text: Mock taken around start of summer recess

indicators.note: taken around signals the word for mock wraps round the next letter

parts.note: to ape is to imitate mockingly

indicators.note: start of picks the first letter of summer

explanation.surface: Someone is teased at the beginning of the summer holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: A semicircular recess at the end of a church, usually behind the altar.

clue.text: State university starts teaching ancient history

indicators.note: starts picks the first letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A state college begins teaching old history.
explanation.definitionFit: A Mormon-settled state in the western US.

clue.text: Musical composition to catch on the heart

indicators.note: the heart signals the following word goes into the middle of the word for catch

parts.note: to net a fish is to catch it
taken as written

explanation.surface: A piece of music meant to capture the listener's heart.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece written for nine instruments or voices.

clue.text: I'm open about one for those who hate waiting

definitions.note: an adjective is needed: those who hate waiting are described as restless, so the definition is read as describing them

parts.note: taken as written, without the apostrophe

indicators.note: about signals the word for open goes around the numeral

parts.note: patent means plainly open or obvious
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A confession of openness on behalf of anyone who cannot stand queues.
explanation.definitionFit: Restless and unwilling to wait describes people who hate delays.

clue.text: Inserted plug in leak — a daring exploit

indicators.note: Inserted signals that one piece is put into another
in shows which piece receives the inserted piece

parts.note: gas can escape, or leak, from a pipe
to plug a product is to advertise it, so a plug is an ad

explanation.surface: A plumber stuffs a bung into a leaking pipe in a bold feat.
explanation.definitionFit: A reckless adventure or prank is an exploit of this kind.

clue.text: Why is cocktail mixed together with spirit?

indicators.note: mixed together signals the letters are stirred into a new order

parts.note: the tail of cock is its last letter, K

explanation.surface: Someone asks why a mixed drink is blended with liquor.
explanation.definitionFit: Scotch and its kin are distilled grain spirits.
